title: Incorrect variable used when calculating supply
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  When calculating the intermediate `_r` in the `_calculateSupply` function in the pool contract, the function uses the following logic.  ```solidity _r = FixedPointMathLib.rawDiv(     FixedPointMathLib.rawMul(_s, _sp), _s);     // _r*_sp/_s ```  The comment is correct, but the implementation is incorrect. It should use `_r` instead of `s`.
